metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for engineering process: blind multi-model review with adjudication.

plugins.name: blind-review
plugins.description: Two reviewers from different model families read a PR blind and in parallel; a third family adjudicates only where they disagree. Findings without evidence are dropped.

plugins.name: site-preflight
plugins.description: Runs the mechanical half of a twenty-item launch checklist against a live site and reports the measured number behind every verdict. The six items no script can judge are asked of a human, one at a time. Unreadable is could-not-check, never a pass.
